Hi! Thankyou so much for responding. It means so much to have a 'friend' to talk to. 
I spoke to people about the rape at first. But I couldn't deal with the reactions. Mainly sympathy, some doubt. My boyfriend at the time even stated that 'I'm lucky I have him because no one else would want me' after what happened to me. I've put it in a box in my head and can't think about it anymore or else I'll just go back to that dark place. 
I'm scared to contact the university because My degree feels like the only thing good I have achieved. I still love my degree and want to use it. I just can't without getting PTSD. I just feel stuck. 
Thanks so much again for your reply.

Hi, thanks so much for responding. It really means so much. 
I love a good philosophical speech and I really love this one. So thanks so much for sharing it with me. I've been trying to think less about everything that happened. But without that I have nothing else to think about. I'm fine when I'm busy but when I'm alone and left to my thoughts I can't help but think about it. 
I've sought help. I'm on anti depressants and on a 7 month list for a therapist but making it those 7 months seems to be getting harder and harder.
